svg.title: Mismatch, bounded correction, and evidence boundary
svg.desc: Three panels show observed training-period water-temperature mismatch by horizon, the anchor-bounded correction, an excluded-input header, and registry-derived HUC2 counts with a failed inference gate.

cc:Work.dc:title: Mismatch, bounded correction, and evidence boundary
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Mismatch, bounded mechanism, and evidence/claim boundary. (a) Across 120 equally weighted stations, distributions of the station median absolute observed water-temperature change at 1-, 3-, and 7-day horizons, using exact-day pairs whose two endpoints fall in the 2006--2015 training interval. (b) The canonical bounded correction restricts the prediction's deviation from the frozen anchor to less than delta; this is not an error bound or safety guarantee. (c) The 657,480-row panel reduces to 120 station units across 15 pre-attrition HUC2 groups. Target WTEMP at t+h and horizon-specific future weather are excluded predictor inputs. Registry-derived counts feed the frozen inference gate; two of three criteria fail, limiting interpretation to fixed-cohort descriptive evidence. Dated covariates are latest-available retrospective products, not as-issued operational vintages.
